allowedWork: Implement only the 28 approved economics exemplar slices, focused tests, stable visual and performance harness extensions, progressive tutorial custom-element renderers, and durable project/Theseus evidence.
Continue through objective exemplar slices under advance approval, but freeze all visual acceptance and cross-caller promotion at the final human checkpoint.
disallowedWork: Do not implement solve-x as a second caller, promote shared reader or motif contracts, adopt SvelteKit, build Public Web or an editor, or roll motion blocks across the catalogue.
Do not build a universal scene graph, layout engine, motif registry, economics engine, client KaTeX compiler, live LLM prose path, surplus/deadweight-loss lesson, or resume matrix work.
goal: Deliver two cumulative economics motion blocks with viewport-synchronized local timelines, reversible stage composition, semantic deep links, progressively enhanced portable controls, low-JS evidence, and a frozen human review checkpoint.
stopConditions: Stop on source-of-truth conflict, competing execution authority, or unavoidable overlap with unrelated user-owned files.
Stop if cumulative economics state is nondeterministic, scroll and manual ownership cannot reconcile without a jump, or exact model truth would change.
Stop if delivery requires eager heavy capabilities, client KaTeX, widened performance targets, fidelity loss, or framework ownership of semantic/runtime authority.
Stop when required verification is missing or contradictory, or when the final economics human visual checkpoint is review-ready.

slices.title: Record-approved-direction
slices.summary: Recorded the accepted 28-slice direction, supersession boundaries, preservation/rollback rules, explicit deferrals, roadmap priority, and explanation-attention next action.

slices.title: Define-motion-block-contract
slices.summary: Defined two economics-local motion blocks with six named checkpoints and an exact shifted-state handoff; no generic reader contract was introduced.

slices.title: Build-cumulative-projection
slices.summary: Added history-independent cumulative projection with explicit initial, shifting, shifted, supply-trace, and verified presentation states.

slices.title: Author-second-motion-block
slices.summary: Annotated the unchanged demand-shift and shift-versus-movement prose as two unique local motion blocks and added fail-closed compiler validation.

slices.title: Render-first-motion-block
slices.summary: Rendered the first demand-shift passage and its unchanged text-free scrubber as one labeled semantic motion-block boundary, with contiguous lesson styling and no second-block surface yet.

slices.title: Define-scroll-corridors
slices.summary: Added economics-local viewport corridors whose authored start, checkpoint holds, and settlement map monotonically and identically in either scroll direction; dense deterministic sampling passed.

slices.title: Centralize-scroll-coordination
slices.summary: Moved all lesson scroll/resize observation into one coalesced coordinator, removed per-scrubber viewport listeners, proved exclusive block ownership, and preserved crossing autoplay until continuous seek lands.

slices.title: Bind-first-scroll-timeline
slices.summary: Bound the first demand-shift corridor directly to paused semantic seeks, removed crossing autoplay and its public event/status residue, and proved down, stop, up, holds, manual ownership, and reduced-motion behavior.

slices.title: Bind-second-cumulative-timeline
slices.summary: Rendered the supply-movement motion block, bound its corridor to cumulative projection, and proved its local rewind stops at the demand block's exact settled state; manual block-two controls remain disabled until takeover rebasing.

slices.title: Reconcile-manual-and-scroll-ownership
slices.summary: Enabled both local control sets, added manual supply playback and checkpoint stepping, canceled active clocks on takeover, and used inverse-corridor rebasing so the next deliberate scroll resumes without a visible discontinuity.

slices.title: Animate-supply-movement-interpretation
slices.summary: Added a hidden-by-default semantic SVG interpretation layer, drove unchanged-supply emphasis and an E0-to-E1 trace from local progress, revealed exact endpoint targets at verification, and captured the economics-local visual exemplar.

slices.title: Match-graph-label-backings
slices.summary: Matched economics labels and synchronized equations to the exact graph-plane token across contiguous tutorial, phone, and catalogue surfaces; retained legibility with a bounded glyph outline instead of blur or backing patches.

slices.title: Define-stage-composition-projection
slices.summary: Added a pure economics-local stage composition projection: one invariant stage, graph and verification surfaces, logical normalized slots, an inline-end aperture, smooth reversible composition, and exact merged/split endpoints integrated with cumulative lesson state.

slices.title: Add-aperture-ingress-egress
slices.summary: Bound cumulative composition to one fixed outer stage: the graph moves through normalized slot geometry while an empty frameless verification surface enters/exits through a clipped inline-end aperture; midpoint, split, reverse merge, phone omission, and invariant dimensions are browser-proven.

slices.title: Reveal-verification-math
slices.summary: Added a framework-neutral static KaTeX/MathML renderer for five exact comparison expressions, kept its pure reveal projection free of renderer dependencies, revealed three complete semantic groups, and synchronized the unchanged-supply and E0/E1 graph targets without typing effects.

slices.title: Render-semantic-toc
slices.summary: Added explicit stable section annotations, a framework-neutral hierarchical TOC model/static renderer, compact baseline styling, and ordinary section/block/checkpoint hrefs with matching lesson anchors; the undefined kp-tutorial-toc already carries complete useful light DOM.

slices.title: Enhance-toc-web-component
slices.summary: Enhanced the existing static kp-tutorial-toc light DOM in place with one semantic active destination and a cancelable bubbling composed navigation-intent event; ordinary anchor navigation remains the no-JavaScript fallback, and the Svelte host only calls the element public method.

slices.title: Progressively-enhance-scrubber
slices.summary: Replaced client-created shadow controls with a pure static renderer that emits complete final-geometry light DOM, native checkpoint links, and disabled playback/seek fallbacks; the custom element upgrades those exact nodes in place, retains its public event contract, and changes no measured geometry.

slices.title: Expand-concise-authoring
slices.summary: Added one pure economics publication compiler that expands concise Markdown section/passage/motion annotations and local motion metadata into frozen TOC, scrubber, native-link, and static KaTeX payloads; the route entry no longer assembles custom-element internals, and incomplete motion annotation coverage fails closed.

slices.title: Define-semantic-url-contract
slices.summary: Added a strict framework-neutral semantic destination parser/serializer for section, block, and named checkpoint fragments; it preserves base paths and queries, canonicalizes valid slugs, rejects numeric choreography and malformed inputs, and now owns every generated economics TOC and scrubber href.
